how_built: Claims are real excerpts from the S3 live canary ledger and the Check A harvest (lightly trimmed). Sentences are hand-written: a faithful and an overstated rewrite per claim, plus tricky cases (hedge word kept but overstated; limit kept without a listed hedge word; claims with no hedge).
